title: 1963 decision document
prompt: Create one complete 16:9 documentary image for CAMP CENTURY. Image1 establishes the OWNER-APPROVED DRAWING STYLE ONLY: confident detailed ink and charcoal linework, restrained watercolor, paper tooth, blue-white snow, olive winter clothes, sparse rusty ochre objects. Do not copy its composition or subjects unless requested. Any additional image is FACT reference only. Match the drawing style, not a new design system. Full finished composition, large explanatory drawing, legible short English labels integrated into the scene/paper. A large thoughtful historical editorial notebook spread, not a fake cancellation order. Left two-thirds show detailed watercolor-and-ink Greenland snow swallowing the low abandoned entrance to a research settlement; right third shows a closed plain planning folder and an integral short dated annotation. Only text: PROJECT ICEWORM; 1963; Proposal rejected; Missile network never completed. No seals, names, signatures, classified stamps or weapon diagrams. Keep the dominant human-scale snow environment, not an empty title card. All base artwork must be CLEAN: NO yellow highlighting, NO underlines, NO marker strokes, NO selection circles, NO loupes, NO glow or animated accents baked into the image; those are added later in DaVinci Resolve. No generic three-line title card, UI, HUD, floating boxes, fake official seals/signatures/stamps, tiny filler text, placeholders, empty panels, decorative noise or burnt parchment. Use 6 percent safe margins. This is authored explanatory artwork, not an original archival record. No invented quantities, dimensions or measurement curves. No other projects or bases. Text only as explicitly specified.
